Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made a critical error in Step 4 by instructing the Coder to use a chess engine on a reconstructed FEN string (`rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR`) which represents the standard starting position of a chess game. This was a hallucination based on a failed OCR attempt. The actual image contained a specific mid-game position (which is a known puzzle where Black wins with a back-rank mate, typically involving a Queen and Rook or similar setup), not the starting position. By analyzing the wrong board state (the starting position), the subsequent analysis would have yielded a move like "1. ... Nf6" or similar, which is completely irrelevant to the actual puzzle presented in the image. The failure to correctly interpret the image content before feeding it to the engine caused the entire solution to be based on false premises.
